targets.rawSql:
SELECT                                                                                                                                                                                 
      s.STEP_EXECUTION_ID as "Step ID",                                                                                                                                                    
      s.STEP_NAME as "Step Name",                                                                                                                                                          
      (c.SHORT_CONTEXT::jsonb ->> 'partitionId') as "Partition",                                                                                                                           
      (c.SHORT_CONTEXT::jsonb ->> 'minValue') as "Min Offset",                                                                                                                             
      (c.SHORT_CONTEXT::jsonb ->> 'maxValue') as "Max Offset",                                                                                                                             
      s.STATUS as "Status",                                                                                                                                                                
      s.READ_COUNT as "Read",                                                                                                                                                              
      s.WRITE_COUNT as "Written"                                                                                                                                                           
    FROM BATCH_STEP_EXECUTION s                                                                                                                                                            
    LEFT JOIN BATCH_STEP_EXECUTION_CONTEXT c ON s.STEP_EXECUTION_ID = c.STEP_EXECUTION_ID                                                                                                  
    WHERE s.JOB_EXECUTION_ID = (                                                                                                                                                           
        SELECT JOB_EXECUTION_ID FROM BATCH_JOB_EXECUTION                                                                                                                                   
        WHERE JOB_INSTANCE_ID = ${instanceId} ORDER BY JOB_EXECUTION_ID DESC LIMIT 1                                                                                                       
    )                                                                                                                                                                                      
    ORDER BY s.START_TIME ASC;

SELECT                                                                                                                                                                                 
      s.STEP_NAME as "Step Name",                                                                                                                                                          
      s.STATUS as "Status",                                                                                                                                                                
      s.READ_COUNT as "Read",                                                                                                                                                              
      s.WRITE_COUNT as "Written",                                                                                                                                                          
      s.COMMIT_COUNT as "Commits",                                                                                                                                                         
      s.ROLLBACK_COUNT as "Rollbacks",                                                                                                                                                     
      s.FILTER_COUNT as "Filtered",                                                                                                                                                        
      (s.READ_SKIP_COUNT + s.WRITE_SKIP_COUNT + s.PROCESS_SKIP_COUNT) as "Total Skips",                                                                                                    
      s.START_TIME as "Start Time",                                                                                                                                                        
      s.END_TIME as "End Time",                                                                                                                                                            
      s.EXIT_MESSAGE as "Exit Message",                                                                                                                                                    
      COALESCE(c.SHORT_CONTEXT, c.SERIALIZED_CONTEXT) as "Context JSON"                                                                                                                    
    FROM BATCH_STEP_EXECUTION s                                                                                                                                                            
    LEFT JOIN BATCH_STEP_EXECUTION_CONTEXT c ON s.STEP_EXECUTION_ID = c.STEP_EXECUTION_ID                                                                                                  
    WHERE s.JOB_EXECUTION_ID = (                                                                                                                                                           
        SELECT JOB_EXECUTION_ID                                                                                                                                                            
        FROM BATCH_JOB_EXECUTION                                                                                                                                                           
        WHERE JOB_INSTANCE_ID = ${instanceId}                                                                                                                                              
        ORDER BY JOB_EXECUTION_ID DESC                                                                                                                                                     
        LIMIT 1
    )
    ORDER BY s.START_TIME ASC;

SELECT                                                                                                                                                                                 
      PARAMETER_NAME as "Parameter Name",                                                                                                                                                  
      PARAMETER_VALUE as "Value"                                                                                                                                                           
    FROM BATCH_JOB_EXECUTION_PARAMS
    WHERE JOB_EXECUTION_ID = (
        SELECT JOB_EXECUTION_ID 
        FROM BATCH_JOB_EXECUTION 
        WHERE JOB_INSTANCE_ID = ${instanceId} 
        ORDER BY JOB_EXECUTION_ID DESC 
        LIMIT 1
    );

SELECT                                                                                                                                                                                 
      STATUS as "Status",                                                                                                                                                                  
      EXIT_CODE as "Exit Code",                                                                                                                                                            
      START_TIME as "Start Time",                                                                                                                                                          
      END_TIME as "End Time",                                                                                                                                                              
      EXIT_MESSAGE as "Exit Message"                                                                                                                                                       
    FROM BATCH_JOB_EXECUTION                                                                                                                                                               
    WHERE JOB_INSTANCE_ID = ${instanceId}                                                                                                                                                  
    ORDER BY JOB_EXECUTION_ID DESC                                                                                                                                                         
    LIMIT 1;

SELECT STEP_NAME as "Step Name", STATUS as "Status", READ_COUNT as "Read", WRITE_COUNT as "Written"                                                                                
        FROM BATCH_STEP_EXECUTION                                                                                                                                                          
        WHERE JOB_EXECUTION_ID = (SELECT JOB_EXECUTION_ID FROM BATCH_JOB_EXECUTION WHERE JOB_INSTANCE_ID = ${instanceId})                                                                  
        ORDER BY START_TIME ASC;
